title: incident-bot: add oncall helper commands and SLO-toolkit diagnostic integrations
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: on-call responders frequently ask for a compact set of diagnostic helpers and SLO context when paged. This PR adds new oncall helper commands to incident-bot and plugs them into the SLO-toolkit diagnostics pipeline so runbooks and SLO context are surfaced in a single compact response. Changes include: new /oncall summary and /oncall links commands; SLO-toolkit helpers that fetch and format SLO buckets and recent error windows; runbook auto-linker improvements to prefer critical-runbooks and shortlinks; UI tweaks to collapse verbose diagnostics by default. Backwards compatibility: commands are additive and opt-in via feature flag INCIDENT_ONCALL_HELPERS. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to internal staging cluster for 48h, follow metrics and oncall feedback, then enable for production. Checklist: [x] unit tests for helpers added; [x] integration tests covering command end-to-end; [x] docs updated; [x] feature flag gated. Related: Linear ENG-4123, ENG-4210; Support ticket SUP-1024.
